typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDESTOTCCLYRuleDef_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RULE_NAME as string,
		WORKFLOW_ID as decimal(38,0),
		STATUS as string,
		POSSIBLE_ACTION as string,
		RESULTING_STATUS as string,
		CREATE_DTE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSrceClyRule	source(output(
		Impacted_Keyword as string,
		Create_Dte as timestamp,
		Rule as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSrceOTCTradeRuleDef
OLEDBSrceClyRule derive(sRESULTING_STATUS = RESULTING_STATUS,
		sPOSSIBLE_ACTION = POSSIBLE_ACTION,
		sSTATUS = STATUS,
		sRULE_NAME = RULE_NAME,
		sWORKFLOW_ID = toString(WORKFLOW_ID),
		sCREATE_DTE = CREATE_DTE) ~> DataConversionVarchar
DataConversionVarchar sort(asc(sRULE_NAME, false)) ~> Sort
OLEDBSrceOTCTradeRuleDef,Sort join(Rule == sRULE_NAME,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		sCREATE_DTE = OLEDBSrceOTCTradeRuleDef@sCREATE_DTE,
		Rule_Name = sRULE_NAME,
		WORKFLOW_ID = sWORKFLOW_ID,
		Impacted_Keyword = Impacted_Keyword,
		Original_Status = sSTATUS,
		Possible_Action = sPOSSIBLE_ACTION,
		Resulting_Status = sRESULTING_STATUS
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
MergeJoin01 derive(Impacted_Keyword = Impacted_Keyword,
		sRULE_NAME = sRULE_NAME,
		sSTATUS = sSTATUS,
		sPOSSIBLE_ACTION = sPOSSIBLE_ACTION,
		sRESULTING_STATUS = sRESULTING_STATUS,
		sCREATE_DTE = sCREATE_DTE,
		sWORKFLOW_ID = sWORKFLOW_ID) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Rule_Name as string,
		WORKFLOW_ID as string,
		Impacted_Keyword as string,
		Original_Status as string,
		Possible_Action as string,
		Resulting_Status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = sCREATE_DTE,
		Rule_Name = sRULE_NAME,
		WORKFLOW_ID = sWORKFLOW_ID,
		Impacted_Keyword,
		Original_Status = sSTATUS,
		Possible_Action = sPOSSIBLE_ACTION,
		Resulting_Status = sRESULTING_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDESTOTCCLYRuleDef_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDESTOTCCLYRuleDef
